name: rsat4-airbag-reset
label: RSAT4 airbag reset
description: Reads the module state, then clears the crash record so the module can be reused.
warning: Clears the stored crash record on the airbag module. Irreversible, and it destroys the evidence of an accident.
_unverified: Not run against a vehicle. Slug and request names are checked against the database; the effect is not.
